matching: grayscale unwarped square-patch zero-mean NCC with bilinear subpixel patch sampling
image_resize: PIL convert L then resize to explicit (width,height), BILINEAR; calibration uses K_half
depth_grid: entire public reference optical Z domain at PROTOCOL depth_step_mm; no candidate-dependent search
ambiguity: retain every NCC-threshold connected grid component and every local maximum in it; flat maxima use plateau midpoint; no top-k truncation
finite_representation: continuous matches between grid samples and nonmaximum within-component coordinates are not exhaustively enumerated
interval_rule: threshold component sample extent expanded by half a grid step and interval_padding_mm, clipped to public domain; observed-pixel reprojection support sampled on same grid and expanded by same amount; intersect supports
star: all independently measured ref-source local maximum pairs with common reference-ray support and joint three-view reprojection check
star_full: intersection of complete padded ref-source threshold components before finite local-maximum representation and geometry checks
cycle: subset of star; from each fixed observed source1 peak directly scan source2 over the full public reference-Z domain along that source1 ray; retain all direct components/local maxima; require measured source2 coordinate agreement, common support, joint four-observation triangulation/reprojection with both source2 observations
direct_direction: source1 to source2 only; no reverse-cycle requirement
triangulation: linear pixel-coordinate least squares using K[R|-RC]; positive depth in every observed camera; reference depth in public domain
empty_semantics: empty_unknown; no target-layer conclusion and no vacuous sign certificate
assumption: finite engineering admissibility intervals with assumed NCC, pixel, and depth-padding tolerances; not calibrated confidence sets or complete physical feasible sets
io_policy: strict request-row/camera schema and Python open allowlist; not an OS sandbox
run_scope: 21 frozen requests in two historical scenes; no candidate coordinates, source depth maps, reference geometry, or evaluation access
tuning: all numeric parameters imported from pre-extraction locked PROTOCOL observation object; no evaluation-driven changes
